research_rationale:
basis_pattern: original_plus_bounded_search. EO 13973 (signed 2021-01-08; 86 FR 3733; official Federal Register text jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_13973.txt, read in full) prescribes the order in which officials of the Environmental Protection Agency act as Administrator when the Administrator and Deputy Administrator cannot serve, states exceptions, revokes Executive Order 13763 and adds a no-rights provision. Identity: the Title 3 heading of Executive Order 13973 of January 8, 2021, on an order of succession within the Environmental Protection Agency at 86 FR 3733, the title and the date agree with the register row. The dossier inventory has twenty-three clauses (section 1 and paragraphs (a) to (q), section 2 and its paragraphs (b) and (c), and sections 3 and 4); I confirmed it without correction. Own terms: no clause of sections 1, 2 or 4 has an end date or ending condition; section 3 is a self-executing revocation of EO 13763 performed on issuance and recorded as terminated on 2021-01-08. Later instruments: a search of every held order text for the number 13973 finds only the order's own Federal Register copy and the Federal Register page text of 2021; the dossier chain has no event and lists no actor. No held text revokes, supersedes or amends it. The three selected machine searches (current-law:usc, current-law:ecfr, later-events:ofr_catalog) were read with their coverage notes, carry no coverage warning, and record 0, 0 and 0 hits for the order number respectively. Limit stated plainly: the continuing predicate rests on the held original text and the bounded searches (U.S. Code through 2026-10-09), which record 0 hits; the Federal Vacancies Reform Act text is not held, and the held evidence does not show whether any listed office was renamed or abolished or a later succession order was issued, which would have appeared as a held order text naming this number.
